optimizedDescription.value: Modelo inmutable de nodos, referencias y bindings estructurados para grafo de código agnóstico de lenguaje.

optimizedContext.value:
# Symbol Model

## Rules

- FileNode: canonical workspace:path, config path, language/hash/workspace, optional Float32Array embedding. SpecNode canonical ID/content/dependencies. SymbolNode deterministic occurrence ID, 1-based line/0-based column. DocumentNode searchable non-code.
- Immutable FileAnalysisDraft/FileAnalysis data: symbols/imports/scoped bindings/calls/namespaces; never retain AST. Optional ParserState/AdapterSessionState caches; IndexSession/SymbolIndex semantic lookup.
- Closed SymbolKind: function, class, method, variable, type, interface, enum. Relation types: IMPORTS, DEPENDS_ON, DEFINES, EXPORTS, CALLS, CONSTRUCTS, USES_TYPE, EXTENDS, IMPLEMENTS, OVERRIDES, COVERS_FILE, COVERS_SYMBOL.
- ImportDeclaration describes local/original/specifier/relative + named|namespace|default|side-effect|dynamic|require|blank. EXTENDS inherited type; IMPLEMENTS contract; OVERRIDES persisted replacement.
- Facts model nested scopes, bindings and calls. Scope cycles return no result; self-relations dropped; unresolved facts diagnostics only.
- Logical symbols/bindings distinct from occurrences; canonical refs stable across shifts; preserve language case, public/local provenance, coverage status/hash.

## Constraints

- Structural value equality except deterministic SymbolNode.id.
- No reflection/interprocedural flow. SpecdCodeGraphError extends SpecdError.
- Runtime @specd/core; embedding/coverage edges version-gated.
